scope: Step-400 development export packaging probe only. Not the final candidate or a published model.
initial_check: Rejected because the first checker incorrectly expected full model metadata in every shard. The pinned splitter stores that metadata only in the first shard. Original shards were preserved and rechecked with the documented layout.

loader.scope: One loader/API smoke check, not a model-quality measurement

commands: After diagnosing the first refusal, repeat with --verify-existing to check the same files
checks: Every tensor name, shape, type and raw byte sequence matches the original
First-shard metadata matches the original; later shards contain only the file version and split bookkeeping
All three shard sizes are below 2 GiB
Eight-slot native server loads the shards with the registered chat template and answers an API request
